snippet.title: ICE SCREAM UNITED OFFICIAL TRAILER 🍦 Ice Scream ONLINE MULTIPLAYER GAME 🤩
snippet.description:
What if during the events of Ice Scream 4... just in the beginning, a thunder hit the factory and messed up the entire electric system? What if the kids' cages open because of this? Well this is it! In this game you will be able to play online your favourite horror game Ice Scream 🍧 Do not miss this amazing game and try it out with your friends! Coming next week 🤩

ICE SCREAM UNITED 🥶
🔸 G-Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.keplerians.icescreamunited
